evidence: MeterReadingScreen.tsx:52 pulls only { isConnected, addToQueue } from useOfflineSupport — no processQueue, no direct apiRequest. handleSubmit (:99-145) ALWAYS calls addToQueue({endpoint:'/api/v1/meter-readings', method:'POST', ...}) regardless of connectivity, sets syncStatus:'syncing' when isConnected, then immediately shows Alert t('meters.submitSuccess') (:136).

The offline queue is only flushed by useOfflineSupport's NetInfo.addEventListener callback 'when coming back online' (useOfflineSupport.ts:593-619, processQueue at :601) or by the manual retry handler App.tsx:88-90. addToQueue (useOfflineSupport.ts:676-700) never triggers processQueue.

Consequence: a reading submitted while the device is already online and STAYS online is enqueued but never POSTed until the next connectivity transition (disconnect->reconnect) or app relaunch — yet the user was told it succeeded. Data-delivery gap on the happy path.

Contrast / correct pattern: screens/faults/ReportFaultScreen.tsx does a direct apiRequest('/api/v1/faults', POST) at :385 when online and only addToQueue (:340) when offline. Fix: mirror that dual-path in MeterReadingScreen (direct POST when connected, enqueue only when offline) or call processQueue() right after addToQueue when connected. Frontend-only, cloud-landable.

PersonMonthsScreen.tsx has NO useTranslation import and no t() calls anywhere — all user-facing strings are hardcoded English, e.g. :78 Alert.alert('Invalid value', 'Enter a whole number between 0 and 20.'), plus the screen's labels/headers.

Every sibling mobile screen uses react-i18next (verified: Neighbors, WidgetSettings, Feedback, HelpCenter, Dashboard, Buildings, Leases*, LeaseSignature all import useTranslation). This screen is the lone i18n outlier, so it ships English to sk/cs/de/en users regardless of selected locale.

Independent of the screen's documented mock-data TODO (its header NOTE explains the backend person-months endpoint is a follow-up) — the i18n gap is a separate, cloud-landable fix: wrap strings in t() with keys in the person-months namespace and add the keys to all 4 locale files. Frontend-only, cloud-landable.
